why.forcePush: force push or deletion of a remote branch
why.mergeRequest: merging a merge request / pull request
what.deleteFiles: `rm` with the option `-r`, `-R`, `-f`, `--recursive`, or `--force`. Example: `rm -rf node_modules`.
what.deleteFilesAsRoot: `sudo rm`, with or without an option.
what.findDelete: `find` with the option `-delete`, or with `-exec rm`.
what.dockerPrune: `prune` with `-a`, `-af`, or `--all`, and `system prune`. Example: `docker system prune -af`.
what.dockerForceRemove: `docker rm`, `docker rmi`, or `docker volume rm` with the option `-f`.
what.forcePush: `git push` with `--force`, `-f`, `--force-with-lease`, a branch that starts with `+`, `--delete`, `-d`, or a refspec of the form `:branch`.
what.gitClean: `git clean` with the option `-f`, alone or with other letters, for example `-fd`.
what.discardChanges: `git checkout -f`, `git checkout -- .`, `git restore .`, `git stash clear`, and `git stash drop`.
what.sqlDrop: `DROP` or `TRUNCATE` of a `TABLE`, a `DATABASE`, or a `SCHEMA`, in upper case or in lower case.
what.sqlDeleteWithoutWhere: `DELETE FROM` a table with no `WHERE` clause. Example: `DELETE FROM users;`.
what.production: A command that has the word `prod` or `production` and one of the words `rm`, `drop`, `delete`, `restart`, `stop`, or `down`, in any order.
